name: Ring L-Sit
steps: Press into a straight-arm support hold on gymnastic rings with locked elbows and depressed shoulder blades.
Keep the rings tucked close to your hips, brace your abs tightly, and lock both knees straight.
Lift your straight legs together forward until they sit parallel to the floor, forming a crisp right angle at your hips.
Hold steadily for the target duration without letting your legs drop or shoulders shrug, then lower cleanly.
tips: Press downward firmly through the rings so your shoulders stay depressed away from your ears.
Point your toes and squeeze your quads hard to keep your legs completely straight and level.
